topic: Dragon's red line for Sabo was never about loyalty, it was about the Army's ideals
title: Dragon Drew One Hard Line For Sabo Over Cobra
description: Dragon said he would never forgive Sabo if the story about King Cobra were true. I think that line tells you what the Revolutionary Army actually is. Is Dragon right to draw it?
comment: Was Dragon right to say he'd never forgive Sabo, or should he have trusted him with no conditions? Pick one.

lines.text: Dragon told Sabo there was one thing he would never forgive, even from his own right hand.

shot.search: Monkey D. Dragon Sabo Revolutionary Army
shot.fallback: hooded leader facing a younger commander

lines.text: If the newspaper about King Cobra were true, Dragon said, that would be the end of it.

shot.fallback: hooded leader reading a newspaper with a cold look

lines.text: People assume that's Dragon being harsh. I think it's the cleanest rule the Army has.

shot.fallback: hooded commander with a stern face

lines.text: Harming a benevolent royal is simply not what the Army is for, and Dragon knows it.

shot.fallback: revolutionary soldiers standing against a palace

lines.text: Now the detail most people forget. Dragon is the one who pulled Sabo out of the wreck when he was ten.

shot.fallback: hooded leader lifting an injured boy from the water

lines.text: So the warning isn't distrust. It's respect, and a refusal to bend the Army's rules for family.

shot.fallback: leader resting a hand on a younger man's shoulder

lines.text: That's why Sabo had to tell him everything. The Throne, Imu, and what the Elders did to Cobra.

shot.search: Sabo tells Dragon Imu Empty Throne
shot.fallback: bandaged man whispering to his leader

lines.text: But if Dragon is the one man Sabo told the truth, who is the lie really aimed at?

shot.fallback: blond man holding a secret under a streetlamp

lines.text: Because Dragon told Sabo there was one thing he would never forgive...

shot.fallback: hooded leader staring at a younger commander

self_check.hook: Dragon and Sabo named in line 1 with a concrete stake
self_check.loop: last line leads back into line 1
